workflow_runs.display_title: Stop the legacy main:/ root from freezing the live board on an old build

head_commit.message:
Keep the legacy main:/ root on the verified build

The public site is served from the committed main:/ root (Pages reports
build_type: legacy), so every push republishes those pages over the artifact the
verified workflow just deployed. On 2026-10-21 that left the board on the frozen
18 Oct build - "Snapshot expired or timestamp unverified. Current picks are
withheld." - three days after the last refresh, with the verified deploy green
minutes earlier.

scripts/publish_root_fallback stages the hash-verified public/ build (and the
matching data/latest.json, so the committed fallback stays reproducible through
scripts.validate --site .) only when the snapshot is readable, inside the 8-hour
evidence window, strictly newer than the committed one, and the committed one is
older than a 4-hour cooldown. pages.yml runs it on every main publication and
commits the result with the workflow token. It can never promote an older or
expired build, which is exactly what produced the frozen board.

13 unit tests; 547 tests OK; build/validate and the browser suite green.

Co-authored-by: arena-agent <297053741+arena-agent@users.noreply.github.com>
